notes.note: Merrett had a bad day with just 11 disposals. His previous lowest was 87!
Merrett racked up another 28 possessions and had a team high 7 tackles. He had that half back role for the first half but did go back into the middle for the last half.
Merrett has gone back to back over 100 now with his 22 disposals this week. A good turnaround from the two under 100 in the previous weeks.
Merrett racked up the footy with 33 disposals and 9 marks but it was the 7 clangers and 66% efficiency that really hurt his score from being much higher.
Merrett did have 28 disposals but his efficiency was restricted to just 57%.  Just the third time this year that he has dropped below triple figures.
36 disposals and 12 marks for Merrett as he continues his good run of form this season. If you are looking for a premium midfielder he is one you must consider.
Merrett was one of just two Bombers over 100 so a good result for owners. He was efficient in the wet with his 84%.
Merrett scored from 31 disposals and 5 marks. He wasn't the most dominant for the Bombers but again one of their best.
Merrett couldn't make it 5 over 100 in a row but only just with his 28 disposals and 1 goal falling two points short of the mark. A good score however in a big loss.
Merrett was the second best for the Bombers with 22 disposals at 86%. When this is your second worst of the season he is still a great own.
Merrett was brilliant for the Bombers. 34 disposals 9 marks and 8 tackles. If you can get him in he will be worth using a trade on.
Merrett again one of the top scoring Bombers. His second best of the season with 31 disposals and a goal.
Merrett had his 30 disposals and 7 tackles this week which was a score and a game which we have very much become accustomed to from him.
Merrett had only 10 disposals as he was tagged by O'Sullivan but it was the 9 tackles that helped with his score. He missed his BE and this was his lowest of the season.

Merrett was one of just three Bombers to hit 100 as he did his best to get the Bombers into the game. It was 25 touches for him at 84%. He is always someone that finds a way to score no matter how his team is going.
After his failed attempt to get to Hawthorn we saw Merrett come out and dominate the game and put up the highest score from 32 disposals and a goal. In only 2.8% of teams he is a fantastic unique.
